cohort: 100 pregnant women with oligohydramnios (AFI <= 5cm) after 34 weeks gestation and 100 pregnant women with normal AFI (8-24cm) after 34 weeks gestation.
finding: Oligohydramnios (AFI <=5cm) after 34 weeks of gestation was associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes including lower birth weight, increased cesarean section rate, and higher rates of thick meconium stained amniotic fluid compared to normal AFI.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was higher in the oligohydramnios group (55%) compared to the control group (19%).
birth_weight: <2.5 kg in 60% of the oligohydramnios group and 18% of the control group; mean birth weight was 2.3kg in the oligohydramnios group and 2.9kg in the control group.
